parameters.title: Detect and remove indicator outliers
parameters.label: Detect and remove indicator outliers using one of the following machine learning models: iforest (isolationforest), ee (eenvelope,ellipticenvelope), lof (lofactor,localoutlierfactor), 1csvm (1c-svm, oneclasssvm).

parameter.hint: The root fp of the project
The dataframe to use as input, raw = original spectra, previous = the latest saved parquet file(s), or state the name of the parquet file with spectra derived from earlier step(s) to use as input.
Comma separated list of the indicators for which to detect outliers

Outlier detector: iforest, ee, lof or 1csvm; or select = run all four with the same threshold, plot them side by side and choose interactively which one to apply. Suffix .olif, .olee, .ollof or .ol1csvm.
The threshold (contamination/nu) to set for detecting
Optional user extension (1-6 letters, digits or -) added to the file suffix after a hashtag, e.g. .ma5#12321, to tell apart outputs with settings the suffix does not show.
